items.title: 2.2 Finding the Intersecting Point(s) Graphically (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle hisse (2.1) mein humne function, domain aur range ko samjha, aur function ka graph banaya. Ab hum graph ka ek bohat kaam ka istemal seekhenge: do (ya zyada) graphs jahan ek doosre se milte hain, us point ko dhoondna. Yeh point sirf ek tasveer nahin hai, balke equations ka hal (solution) hai. Isi liye is tareeqe ko "graphically solve karna" kehte hain.

Kitab ki definition: point of intersection (milne ka point) woh point hai jahan coordinate plane par do ya zyada graphs aapas mein milte hain. Yeh point di gayi functions ki equations ke solution(s) ko represent karta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Milne wala point solution kyun hai? Zara ghor kijiye: \(y = f(x)\) ka graph un tamaam points \((x, y)\) ki tasveer hai jo is equation ko satisfy karte hain (yani equation mein rakhein to dono sides barabar aati hain). Graph ka har point equation ko poora karta hai, aur jo point graph par nahin hai woh equation ko poora nahin karta.
Ab agar koi point do graphs par ek saath para hai, to woh dono equations ko ek hi waqt mein satisfy karta hai. Yahi to system of equations ka solution hota hai: aisi \(x\) aur \(y\) jo dono equations ko saath saath sach kar dein.
Is liye "graphically solve karein" ka matlab hai: dono graphs ek hi axes par banayein, aur jahan woh milte hain us point ke coordinates parh lein.

blocks.title: Teaching note
Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari apni chhoti si misaal hai (kitab ka sawal nahin), sirf idea pakka karne ke liye. Lines \(y = x\) aur \(y = 4 - x\) lijiye.
\(y = x\) ke kuch points: \((0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3)\).
\(y = 4 - x\) ke kuch points: \((0, 4), (1, 3), (2, 2), (3, 1)\).
Dekhiye, \((2, 2)\) dono lists mein hai! Yani dono lines \((2, 2)\) par milti hain. Tasdeeq: \(y = x\) mein \(2 = 2\) sahi, aur \(y = 4 - x\) mein \(2 = 4 - 2\) bhi sahi. Is liye \(x = 2,\ y = 2\) dono equations ka hal hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Kya do alag alag seedhi lines do points par mil sakti hain? Sochiye aur graph bana kar dekhiye. (Jawab: nahin. Do alag lines ya to ek point par milti hain, ya parallel hon to bilkul nahin miltin. Do points par milne ka matlab hoga ke woh ek hi line hain.)

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Graph aankh se parha jata hai, is liye values kabhi kabhi andaze wali (approximate) hoti hain, jaise \(3 - \sqrt{6}\) ki jagah 0.6. Is liye jo point graph se parhein, use dono equations mein rakh kar zaroor check karein. Dono equations satisfy hon to jawab pakka hai. Examiner bhi yeh tasdeeq dekh kar khush hota hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Point of intersection = woh point jo do ya zyada graphs mein common (mushtarka) ho.
2. Us ke coordinates har equation ko satisfy karte hain, is liye wohi system ka solution hain.
3. Graphical tareeqa: saare graphs ek hi axes par, ek hi scale ke saath banayein, phir milne wale points parhein.
4. Parhe hue points ko equations mein rakh kar check karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Dono graphs alag scale ya alag axes par bana dena: phir milne ka point be-maani ho jata hai. Hamesha ek hi graph paper aur ek hi scale.
2. Sirf \(x\) ki value likh dena: point of intersection ke do coordinates hote hain, \((x, y)\). Jawab poora likhein.
3. Kachchi (rough) sketch par bharosa karna: table of values bana kar kam az kam teen chaar sahi points plot karein, phir line ya curve kheenchein.
